parameter.name: local_name_attr
parameter.description: The Entra ID attribute used for the local NSS login name. Available options include: .RS .IP \- SPN (the user principal name) .IP \- onPremisesSamAccountName .RE When onPremisesSamAccountName is configured but unavailable for a user, Himmelblau falls back to SPN.
parameter.conf_description: Attribute used for local NSS login names.
